narration.text: Ab-Soul falls twenty-eight places. Latto falls thirteen. Jay Rock, twelve. Macklemore keeps seventy-three percent of his streams and drops three spots. Drake loses four point four billion streams, keeps ninety-seven percent of his total, and finishes exactly where he started.
narration.measuredTranscript: Absoles falls 28 places. Lotto falls 13. J. Rock 12. Maclamore keeps 73 % of his streams and drops three spots. Drake loses 4 .4 billion streams. He keeps 97 % of his total and finishes exactly where he started.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: Everyone else falls. He does not move.

sourceCandidates: before/after rank table for the 93-rapper field

claims.text: Macklemore keeps 73% of his streams and drops 3 spots.
Drake loses 4.4 billion streams, keeps 97% of his total, and finishes where he started.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Verified before and after rank for all five named artists, from a shared zero start, plus retention percentages for Macklemore and Drake.
Approved headshot through one-quarter-body cutout for each of the five named artists. Spatial rendering rules prohibit deeper crops in spatial marker frames.

visualEvents.description: Macklemore drops 3 spots with a retention readout.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: loses four point four billion streams
visualEvents.description: Drake's stream total decreases while his rank does not.
Drake's marker is visibly unmoved while the others have fallen. The event is the ABSENCE of movement and only reads if the falls are still visible.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not move Drake's marker at any point.
prohibitions.reason: The narration says he finishes exactly where he started.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not imply these five are the only artists who fell.
prohibitions.reason: They are examples drawn from a 93-artist field.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not use unbound placeholder cutouts for the five named artists.
prohibitions.reason: They are named, so the images carry identity.

successConditions: Four markers visibly fall and one visibly does not.
Each fall lands on its artist's name.
Drake's stability is legible at the moment it is spoken.
failureConditions: Drake's stillness is not readable because the others have already left frame.
Falls are not distinguishable from one another.
Portraits are not the named artists.

groundTruth.desired: Truthful before-and-after rank-loss field with Drake nearly fixed while peers fall
